note: Jackson County Conservation's 14-acre park surrounded by water on South Sabula Lake (Mississippi backwater), at the south end of South Ave, Sabula. The sites on the lake side back onto the shore. The only road in passes under a rail bridge; the county page gives its clearance as both 12 ft 5 in and 12 ft 8 in. --Claude
summary: Changed site count 40->39 (county page). Confirmed $25, 50-amp + water, showers, dump, FCFS only, May-Oct; added 14-night limit, paved-site list, water-off date. Max 35 ft not on the page, left. Pin ~60 m from the loop centre.
flags: Waterfront 'lakefront' stands, on the front row only. On imagery at 42.0567,-90.1737 about 8 pads on the northwest side have their spurs running from the loop road toward the lake, ending ~10-15 m from the water across open grass with no road, driveway or day use between (the loop road is behind them). The boat ramp/dock sits at the southwest end of that row. The rest of the ~39 sites are inside the loop, behind that road, with trees between. Site numbers for the front row not on the page; the page's map stayed unread (no link in plain HTML).
Clearance: page gives 12 ft 5 in in the directions and 12 ft 8 in in the note; both pass EKKO (under 10.5 ft).
The feature list includes 'Sewer Connection' but the campsite line says only '50 amp electric and water service' and there is a dump station; I did not write sewer.
Closes for river levels: 'pending weather and river levels' at opening and closing weekends; flood-prone.
